Significance then reads: 'The coordinate and Jacobian compatibilities DEMONSTRATE that the cyclic Z_5-observable structure of the genus-2 substrate X_5 FAITHFULLY SHADOWS the cyclic observable structure of the full S_5-substrate' and 'preserves the cyclic Sylow-5 residue EXACTLY'. 'Faithfully' and 'exactly' assert a fidelity the block has just said it cannot construct - an equality of characters is weaker than a faithful shadow.
